== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 11 August 2018. The uncropped original is in Photographs. The Facebook photo viewer names Butch Branscome. Identification: distinctive name plus Bravo 12 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Charlotte, NC). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/butch.branscome. Comments on the photograph name him Butch.

Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot (Wayback 20261030160101 of the Route C snapshot). Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Butch Branscome Facebook portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Butch Branscome portrait.jpg]].
